name: eagle-video-downloader
description: Download video links supported by yt-dlp and import them into Eagle

scripts.package: npm run build && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('Plugin/bin', { recursive: true, force: true }); const zip = new (require('adm-zip'))(); zip.addLocalFolder('Plugin'); zip.writeZip('视频下载器.eagleplugin');"

author: fansanqiu
